name: CART3R GD AI
description: Experimental AI training controls for Geometry Dash. Gameplay control and learning from real attempts are not implemented yet.

training-enabled.name: Training Enabled
training-enabled.description: Turns the prototype training controller on or off. This does not control the player yet.

learning-rate.name: Learning Rate
learning-rate.description: How strongly the prototype updates its stored values.

training-speed.name: Training Speed
training-speed.description: Prototype update speed setting. This does not change game speed.
